reviews.comment: She started off bad, but actually listened to feedback and restructured her class. I would have pulled out an A but she had to drop 2 quizzes, so my quiz average was stuck low due to them being weighted more. Class is still unorganized regarding the structure. Overall she is a great person, but I wouldn't recommend taking her.

reviews.comment: Interactive professor who is very knowledgeable in her field. It was really hard to hear the professor distinctly without echoes in the room all the time. Wished the class didn't have so much quizzes because the course about the less developed countries was really insightful.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes--Test heavy

reviews.comment: While the class was off to a rough start, Sagbo took classroom feedback and restructured her class material such as quiz/test frequency & difficulty. She would openly talk about it with us in class. Sagbo is a great person, and I am happy she took the feedback and made the class easier.

Don't take!! She is really hard to understand and it is very unclear about what is expected. So many people dropped. The reason the rest of us will pass is because half the class went to the dean. Sweet person, horrible teacher. Try to take a different teacher if at all possible.
reviews.ratingTags: Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The first half of the class was too difficult for it being an elective but it's her first year teaching she took feedback and bettered the class experience overall. Her accent isn't bad she doesn't speak too loud/firmly in the mic the second exam and final is set up for you to win tbh as long as you review what she asks same with the late quizzes.

Overall super nice Professor and easy to talk to. Took the feedback from students and completely rearranged her class to make it more manageable. A very smart woman with a lot of knowledge and experience
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I am not going to lie, this class was horrible for half the semester. However, feedback was given and she took it in stride and made the class manageable and interesting. Not a lot of profs would take student feedback like she did. Restructured the class to mitigate cheating and went about her lectures and exams in a different way. Lots of respect.
I rather get hit by a car then show up for this class! Do not take her at all!! Find another elective or take it with a different professor. Unfairly structured course.

She makes this class unexplainably difficult! All the cheaters in this class are probably getting better grades in this class, but there are intelligent people in econ in this class who do horribly while studying a week in advance! Her PowerPoints does not match the quizzes or exams whatsoever. This class made me contemplate my worth as a student!
